notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2410390/header.jpg?t=1692973417[/img]

Thank you very much for purchasing Pandora's Box!!! As a way of saying thank you to everyone that helped and supported me a new update is live now, adding new customizations and quality of life updates, as well as bug fixes listed below.

- Gamepads are now compatible.
- Backspace now works as a "go back" button.
- 3 new colors and 3 alternative galaxies to unlock.
- Difficulty settings were added to Arcade Mode. Easy mode, for a more slow paced gameplay and faster to progress, and Hard mode for a faster acceleration and challenging expirience.
- New artwork for the library and store page.
- New achievements.
- Customization menu updated for future updates.
- Music volume for the boss was ajusted.

Thank you again, and stay tuned for more updates!!!
